description: The VerifyRips step (plan §20.1; session D), run alone with a StepContext the harness builds, like acquire-steps.cases.json (request, probe, outputs, config, libraries, tree and the expectations; the job is 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001, its staging folder <library path>/.bromelia/staging/<job>). Given also: images {name: header} (a file in the staging folder: 32769 zero bytes, then the header); matroska: what Matroska.probe gives for a file in the staging folder by name ({duration (seconds; null: none), tracks [types], chapters}, or null when mkvmerge can't read it), missing (true: every probe fails with tool.missing {tool: mkvmerge}), cancelled (true: every probe fails with job.cancelled). Calls are recorded in order: 'probe <path>'. Each title's MKV files (AcquireOutput, plan order), then the files no title owns (others: no listing title to compare with, so they must be readable and hold a track) are checked against Probe's listing title of the same index (RipCheck.check): ripcheck.checking {file} as the progress (the file's place among them), notes as ripcheck.note {file, note} warnings, then ripcheck.checked {file, duration (seconds, rounded), tracks, chapters} and ripcheck.trackSubset {file, have, total} when it has fewer tracks than the listing; problems (or ripcheck.unreadable {file}) as rip.checkFailed {title, problem: ripcheck.mismatch {file, problems}} errors (rip.otherCheckFailed {problem} for a file no title owns), and the step fails at the end with rip.failed {reason: rip.titleReason, or the problem itself for a file no title owns} or rip.titlesFailed. Without mkvmerge: ripcheck.cannotCheck (a warning), no MKV is checked, the step succeeds. A kept backup is checked first (BackupCheck.problem): backup.checkFailed {problem}. Data: {checked: [the names that passed: the backup, then the files]}.
